title: Erdős #8 OQ: Optimal Minimum Modulus Bound
description: What is the optimal minimum modulus bound for covering systems? The current best (616,000) enables the counterexample to the Erdős-Graham conjecture on monochromatic covering systems. Equivalent to Erdős #2 OQ-01.

meta.author: Hough (2015); Balister et al. (2022)
originalContributions: empty_monochromatic: PROVED — empty sets are monochromatic
meta.assumptions: 1 axiom: current_bound (Balister et al. 2022 bound of 616,000)

sections.title: Definitions
sections.summary: Self-contained definitions for covering systems, colorings, monochromaticity, and universal bounds.

sections.title: Structural Results
sections.summary: PROVES: monochromatic set properties (singleton, empty, subset), bound monotonicity, impossibility above 616,000, bound-counterexample relationship.
